race.title: BAR 1 Betting 'Proud Supporter Of Irish Racing' Maiden
race.verdict: In a maiden where few arrive with compelling claims last month's Gowran runner-up SANGREAL is taken to go one better at the expense of fellow 3-y-o filly Kashala , who is open to further progress after only 2 starts. Theorist may prove best of the remainder if a return to polytrack sees him recapture the form he showed here at this time last year. SANGREAL (IRE) KASHALA (IRE) THEORIST (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Sangreal (8/13), Kashala (9/4), Duchess Of Down (14/1), Honouramongthieves (16/1), Winter Adventure (16/1), Michinaga (20/1), Jeffnjoe (25/1), Theorist (25/1), Nthea Spirit (66/1), Anaverna (100/1)
